## Pre-merge checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (unit + integration)
- [ ] Manual smoke test of the changed feature
- [ ] Migrations (if any) run cleanly on a fresh DB
- [ ] Audit log captures any new state-changing actions
- [ ] No PII or secrets added to logs / commits / fixtures
- [ ] Touched UI? Confirmed responsive on mobile breakpoints
